correctness.rationale: For four candidates and k=3, each greedy marginal equals a sum of weights 1,1/2,1/3, so integer scaling by 6 permits exact tie tests. Enumerating all multisets of 15 nonempty ballot masks with n=1..7 gives precisely 170543 profiles; removing one occurrence of each present type yields 813960 comparisons. Independent implementation of all winning branches and Kelly min/max checks found anomalies 0,0,0,0,0,0,12; all twelve are one S4 orbit of 2ab+2ac+bd+cd+bcd. Full-profile winners are abc,abd,acd and abstention on ab/ac leads only abc. Thus each has two profitable types occurring twice. This is a logically exhaustive FINITE classification; it makes no claim for other candidate/committee counts or deterministic tie-break rules.
